```{=html}
<style>
  :root {
    --page: #FFFFFF;
    --sidebar: #D9E3E4;
    --surface: #FFFFFF;
    --surface-2: #F1F6F7;
    --line: #DAE3E5;
    --line-strong: #BCCBCE;
    --ink: #1F2C31;
    --ink-2: #536268;
    --ink-3: #78888E;
    --accent: #2780E3;
    --accent-ink: #1B62B0;
    --accent-soft: #E3EEFB;
    --measured: #1A6B4E;
    --measured-soft: #DCEDE4;
    --vendor: #56666D;
    --vendor-soft: #E9EEEF;
    --derived: #86570A;
    --derived-soft: #F6E9CF;
    --flag: #A33227;
    --flag-soft: #F8E4E1;
    --track: #E2E9EA;
    --shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(31, 44, 49, .05), 0 6px 18px rgba(31, 44, 49, .07);
    --sans: "Atkinson Hyperlegible", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
    --mono: ui-monospace, "SFMono-Regular", "Cascadia Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
  }
  body.quarto-dark, :root[data-bs-theme="dark"] {
      --page: #181818;
      --sidebar: #303030;
      --surface: #212121;
      --surface-2: #2A2A2A;
      --line: #3A3A3A;
      --line-strong: #4E4E4E;
      --ink: #F2F2F2;
      --ink-2: #BFC6C8;
      --ink-3: #939A9D;
      --accent: #75AADB;
      --accent-ink: #9CC6EC;
      --accent-soft: #23323F;
      --measured: #6DC49B;
      --measured-soft: #1B2F27;
      --vendor: #A6B1B5;
      --vendor-soft: #2C2C2C;
      --derived: #DCA847;
      --derived-soft: #342A12;
      --flag: #E08278;
      --flag-soft: #3A211E;
      --track: #333;
      --shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, .5), 0 8px 22px rgba(0, 0, 0, .4);
  }

  #gsd * { box-sizing: border-box; }
  #gsd {
    max-width: 1100px; color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--sans);
    font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.55;
  }
  #gsd h1, #gsd h2, #gsd h3, #gsd h4 { margin: 0; font-weight: 700; text-wrap: balance; }
  #gsd a { color: var(--accent); }

  #gsd .page-head { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); padding-bottom: 14px; margin-bottom: 22px; }
  #gsd .page-head p { margin: 8px 0 0; color: var(--ink-2); max-width: 72ch; }

  #gsd h2.section { font-size: 19px; margin: 30px 0 4px; }
  #gsd h2.section:first-of-type { margin-top: 8px; }
  #gsd .section-note { margin: 0 0 14px; color: var(--ink-2); font-size: 14px; }

  /* ---------- panel: mission parameters ---------- */
  #gsd .panel { background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 10px; padding: 18px; box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
  #gsd .panel h3 { font-size: 13px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .07em; color: var(--ink-3); margin-bottom: 10px; }
  #gsd .caps { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; }
  #gsd .cap {
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; cursor: pointer;
    border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 999px; padding: 6px 13px 6px 10px;
    font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--ink-2); background: var(--surface); user-select: none;
  }
  #gsd .cap input { accent-color: var(--accent); margin: 0; }
  #gsd .cap:has(input:checked) { background: var(--accent-soft); border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-ink); font-weight: 700; }
  #gsd .cap:focus-within { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

  #gsd .slider-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(258px, 1fr)); gap: 14px 26px; margin-top: 6px; }
  #gsd .sl { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto; gap: 6px 10px; align-items: center; }
  #gsd .sl .lab { grid-column: 1 / -1; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--ink-2); }
  #gsd .sl .lab input { accent-color: var(--accent); }
  #gsd .sl .lab b { color: var(--ink); font-weight: 700; }
  #gsd .sl .lab .val { margin-left: auto; font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 13px; color: var(--ink); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
  #gsd .sl .end { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 11px; color: var(--ink-3); }
  #gsd .sl input[type="range"] { width: 100%; accent-color: var(--accent); }
  #gsd .sl.off { opacity: .48; }
  #gsd .panel-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; align-items: center; margin-top: 16px; padding-top: 14px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); }
  #gsd .btn {
    font: inherit; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; border-radius: 7px; padding: 8px 18px;
    border: 1px solid var(--accent); background: var(--accent); color: #fff;
  }
  #gsd .btn.ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--accent-ink); }
  #gsd .btn:focus-visible, #gsd .toggle button:focus-visible, #gsd .cap:focus-within, #gsd summary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }
  #gsd .dirty { font-size: 13px; color: var(--derived); }

  /* ---------- results ---------- */
  #gsd .results-bar { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 14px; }
  #gsd .results-bar .count { font-size: 14px; color: var(--ink-2); }
  #gsd .results-bar .count b { color: var(--ink); }
  #gsd .toggle { display: inline-flex; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 7px; overflow: hidden; margin-left: auto; }
  #gsd .toggle button {
    font: inherit; font-size: 13px; cursor: pointer; border: 0; background: var(--surface);
    color: var(--ink-2); padding: 6px 14px;
  }
  #gsd .toggle button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--accent); color: #fff; font-weight: 700; }

  #gsd .cards { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(290px, 1fr)); gap: 16px; }
  #gsd .gcard { background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 10px; overflow: hidden; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
  #gsd .gcard:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
  #gsd .photo { aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; background: var(--surface-2); position: relative; }
  #gsd .photo img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; display: block; }
  #gsd .photo .ribbon {
    position: absolute; left: 10px; bottom: 10px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px;
    font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .03em; text-transform: uppercase;
    background: var(--measured); color: #fff; border-radius: 4px; padding: 3px 8px;
  }
  #gsd .gbody { padding: 14px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 11px; flex: 1; }
  #gsd .gname { display: flex; gap: 10px; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; }
  #gsd .gname h3 { font-size: 17px; }
  #gsd .gname .maker { font-size: 12px; color: var(--ink-3); }
  #gsd .affordance { margin: 0; font-size: 13px; color: var(--ink-2); }

  #gsd .meter { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 74px 1fr auto; gap: 9px; align-items: center; }
  #gsd .meter .k { font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .04em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-3); }
  #gsd .track { height: 6px; border-radius: 3px; background: var(--track); overflow: hidden; }
  #gsd .track.none { background: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, var(--track) 0 5px, transparent 5px 10px); }
  #gsd .track span { display: block; height: 100%; background: var(--accent); border-radius: 3px; }
  #gsd .track span.over { background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(115deg,
    rgba(255, 255, 255, .5) 0 3px, transparent 3px 8px); }
  #gsd .meter .v { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 12px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
  #gsd .meter .v.dim { color: var(--ink-3); }

  #gsd .chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; }
  #gsd .chip { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 11px; background: var(--surface-2); color: var(--ink-2); border-radius: 5px; padding: 3px 7px; }
  #gsd .fit { border-top: 1px solid var(--line); padding-top: 10px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }
  #gsd .fit-row { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: flex-start; font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--ink-2); }
  #gsd .fit-row .ic { flex: 0 0 auto; font-weight: 700; font-family: var(--mono); }
  #gsd .fit-row.ok .ic { color: var(--measured); }
  #gsd .fit-row.warn .ic { color: var(--flag); }
  #gsd .fit-row.unknown .ic { color: var(--ink-3); }
  #gsd .fit-row b { color: var(--ink); font-weight: 700; }

  #gsd .badge {
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: .04em; text-transform: uppercase; border-radius: 4px; padding: 3px 7px;
  }
  #gsd .badge .dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; }
  #gsd .badge.measured { color: var(--measured); background: var(--measured-soft); }
  #gsd .badge.vendor { color: var(--vendor); background: var(--vendor-soft); }
  #gsd .badge.derived { color: var(--derived); background: var(--derived-soft); }
  #gsd .badge.flag { color: var(--flag); background: var(--flag-soft); }

  #gsd details.more { border-top: 1px solid var(--line); margin-top: auto; }
  #gsd details.more summary {
    cursor: pointer; list-style: none; padding: 9px 0 0; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--accent-ink);
  }
  #gsd details.more summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
  #gsd details.more summary::after { content: " ▸"; }
  #gsd details.more[open] summary::after { content: " ▾"; }
  #gsd .more-body { padding-top: 8px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; }
  #gsd .spec { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; gap: 3px 10px; font-size: 12.5px; padding: 5px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
  #gsd .spec:last-of-type { border-bottom: 0; }
  #gsd .spec .sk { color: var(--ink-2); }
  #gsd .spec .sv { font-family: var(--mono); text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
  #gsd .note-list { margin: 0; padding-left: 16px; font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--ink-2); }
  #gsd .note-list li { margin-bottom: 3px; }
  #gsd .linkrow { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; }
  #gsd .linkrow a {
    font-size: 12px; text-decoration: none; color: var(--accent-ink);
    border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 999px; padding: 4px 10px; background: var(--surface);
  }
  #gsd .linkrow a:hover { background: var(--accent-soft); border-color: var(--accent); }

  /* ---------- table view ---------- */
  #gsd .table-wrap { overflow-x: auto; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--surface); }
  #gsd table { border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; font-size: 13px; }
  #gsd th, #gsd td { text-align: left; padding: 9px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); white-space: nowrap; }
  #gsd th { font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .05em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-3); background: var(--surface-2); position: sticky; top: 0; }
  #gsd td.num { font-family: var(--mono); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
  #gsd tbody tr:last-child td { border-bottom: 0; }
  #gsd td .muted { color: var(--ink-3); }

  /* ---------- comparison charts ---------- */
  #gsd .charts { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(290px, 1fr)); gap: 18px; }
  #gsd .chart { background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 10px; padding: 14px 16px; }
  #gsd .chart h4 { font-size: 13px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .06em; color: var(--ink-3); margin-bottom: 10px; }
  #gsd .bar { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 96px 1fr auto; gap: 8px; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 7px; font-size: 12px; }
  #gsd .bar .n { color: var(--ink-2); overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
  #gsd .bar .b { height: 10px; background: var(--track); border-radius: 3px; overflow: hidden; }
  #gsd .bar .b span { display: block; height: 100%; background: var(--accent); border-radius: 3px; }
  #gsd .bar .b.measured span { background: var(--measured); }
  #gsd .bar .val { font-family: var(--mono); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--ink); }
  #gsd .bar.nodata .val { color: var(--ink-3); }
  #gsd .chart .foot { font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--ink-3); margin-top: 8px; }

  #gsd .empty { background: var(--surface-2); border: 1px dashed var(--line-strong); border-radius: 10px; padding: 20px; color: var(--ink-2); }

  #gsd details.schema { margin-top: 30px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--surface); padding: 14px 16px; }
  #gsd details.schema > summary { cursor: pointer; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; }
  #gsd details.schema .cols { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(230px, 1fr)); gap: 14px; margin-top: 12px; }
  #gsd details.schema .f { border-left: 3px solid var(--accent); padding-left: 10px; }
  #gsd details.schema .f b { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 12.5px; }
  #gsd details.schema .f p { margin: 2px 0 0; font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--ink-2); }

  #gsd footer.credits { margin-top: 34px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); padding-top: 14px; font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--ink-3); }
  #gsd footer.credits a { color: var(--accent); }
  #gsd .legend { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px 18px; align-items: center; margin: 14px 0 0; font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--ink-2); }
</style>

<div id="gsd">

      <header class="page-head">
        <p>Comparing the PAM-equipped gliders of the
          <a href="https://nmfs-pam-glider.github.io/GliderRodeo/">NOAA Fisheries Glider Rodeo 2026</a>.
          Same structure Kasey built — capabilities, mission sliders, apply, then your options — with
          photos, sourcing and the rodeo measurements added.</p>
      </header>

      <h2 class="section">Mission Parameters</h2>
      <p class="section-note">Enter requirements for your mission below. Tick a row to make it a
        requirement; leave it unticked and it is ignored. Then press Apply.</p>

      <div class="panel">
        <h3>Capabilities</h3>
        <div class="caps">
          <label class="cap"><input type="checkbox" id="cap-rt"> Real-time comms</label>
          <label class="cap"><input type="checkbox" id="cap-pam"> Acoustic payload</label>
          <label class="cap"><input type="checkbox" id="cap-edge"> Edge compute</label>
          <label class="cap"><input type="checkbox" id="cap-bathy"> Bathy drive</label>
          <label class="cap"><input type="checkbox" id="cap-ice"> Ice capable</label>
          <label class="cap"><input type="checkbox" id="cap-backseat"> Backseat drive</label>
          <label class="cap"><input type="checkbox" id="cap-prop"> Thruster / propeller</label>
          <label class="cap"><input type="checkbox" id="cap-rodeo"> Flew the Rodeo</label>
        </div>
        
        <h3 style="margin-top:20px;">Battery type</h3>
        <div class="caps" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Battery type">
          <label class="cap"><input type="radio" name="battery" id="batt-any" value="any" checked> Any</label>
          <label class="cap"><input type="radio" name="battery" id="batt-rechargeable" value="rechargeable"> Rechargeable</label>
          <label class="cap"><input type="radio" name="battery" id="batt-primary" value="primary"> Primary   (single-use)</label>
        </div>

        <h3 style="margin-top:20px;">Mission parameters</h3>
        <div class="slider-grid">
          <div class="sl off" id="sl-duration">
            <label class="lab"><input type="checkbox" data-for="duration"> <b>Deployment duration</b>
              <span class="val"><span id="v-duration">30</span> days</span></label>
            <span class="end">1</span>
            <input type="range" id="r-duration" min="1" max="730" value="30" step="1">
            <span class="end">730</span>
          </div>
          <div class="sl off" id="sl-depth">
            <label class="lab"><input type="checkbox" data-for="depth"> <b>Maximum depth</b>
              <span class="val"><span id="v-depth">300</span> m</span></label>
            <span class="end">50</span>
            <input type="range" id="r-depth" min="0" max="18" value="4" step="1">
            <span class="end">11,000</span>
          </div>
          <div class="sl off" id="sl-speed">
            <label class="lab"><input type="checkbox" data-for="speed"> <b>Speed needed</b>
              <span class="val"><span id="v-speed">1.0</span> kt</span></label>
            <span class="end">0.2</span>
            <input type="range" id="r-speed" min="0.2" max="3.5" value="1" step="0.1">
            <span class="end">3.5</span>
          </div>
          <div class="sl off" id="sl-mass">
            <label class="lab"><input type="checkbox" data-for="mass"> <b>Maximum weight</b>
              <span class="val"><span id="v-mass">80</span> kg</span></label>
            <span class="end">20</span>
            <input type="range" id="r-mass" min="20" max="200" value="80" step="5">
            <span class="end">200</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <h3 style="margin-top:20px;">Acoustic parameters</h3>
        <div class="slider-grid">
          <div class="sl off" id="sl-freq">
            <label class="lab"><input type="checkbox" data-for="freq"> <b>Highest frequency of interest</b>
              <span class="val"><span id="v-freq">50</span> kHz</span></label>
            <span class="end">1</span>
            <input type="range" id="r-freq" min="1" max="200" value="50" step="1">
            <span class="end">200</span>
          </div>
          <div class="sl off" id="sl-duty">
            <label class="lab"><input type="checkbox" data-for="duty"> <b>Recording duty cycle</b>
              <span class="val"><span id="v-duty">25</span> %</span></label>
            <span class="end">1</span>
            <input type="range" id="r-duty" min="1" max="100" value="25" step="1">
            <span class="end">100</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="panel-actions">
          <button class="btn" id="apply">Apply</button>
          <button class="btn ghost" id="reset">Reset</button>
          <span class="dirty" id="dirty" hidden>Settings changed — press Apply</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <h2 class="section">Your Options</h2>
      <div class="results-bar">
        <span class="count" id="count"></span>
        <div class="toggle" role="group" aria-label="View">
          <button id="view-cards" aria-pressed="true">Cards</button>
          <button id="view-table" aria-pressed="false">Table</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div id="cards" class="cards"></div>
      <div id="tableview" hidden class="table-wrap">
        <table>
          <thead><tr>
            <th>Manufacturer</th><th>Glider</th><th>Max depth (m)</th><th>Endurance (days)</th>
            <th>Speed (kt)</th><th>Mass (kg)</th><th>Capacity (Wh)</th><th>Propeller</th><th>Real-time</th>
            <th>Acoustic</th><th>Ice</th><th>Evidence</th>
          </tr></thead>
          <tbody id="tbody"></tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
      <div id="empty" class="empty" hidden>No glider meets every requirement. Untick the one that is
        least important — depth and duration are usually what rules platforms out.</div>

      <div class="legend">
        <span class="badge measured"><span class="dot"></span>Measured at Rodeo</span>
      </div>

      <h2 class="section">Glider Comparisons</h2>
      <p class="section-note">Only the gliders that matched, on one scale each. Green bars are measured
        at the Rodeo; blue are vendor figures.</p>
      <div class="charts" id="charts"></div>

      <details class="schema">
        <summary>How the data behind this is organised</summary>
        <p style="font-size:13.5px; color:var(--ink-2); margin-top:10px;">
          The cards, table and charts all read one row per glider, extending the columns already in
          <code>gliders_cleaned.csv</code>. Four companion files join on the same <code>id</code>:
          <code>payloads.csv</code> (PAM and sensors), <code>integrations.csv</code> (which payload runs
          on which glider, with evidence), <code>rodeo.csv</code> (straight from
          <code>build_summary.py</code>) and <code>links.csv</code> (so the reference sites appear in the
          same place on every card).</p>
        <div class="cols">
          <div class="f"><b>value__source</b><p>Where the number came from. No source, no publish.</p></div>
          <div class="f"><b>value__confidence</b><p>vendor / measured / derived — what paints the badge.</p></div>
          <div class="f"><b>value__checked</b><p>Date someone last verified it against the source.</p></div>
          <div class="f"><b>conflicts</b><p>Two sources disagree: show both, never silently pick.</p></div>
        </div>
      </details>

      <footer class="credits">
        <p>Glider photographs from the
          <a href="https://open-source-glider.readthedocs.io/en/latest/Commercial%20Gliders.html">open-source glider wiki</a>,
          which credits the manufacturers. Specifications from vendor documentation and manuals;
          at-sea figures from the Glider Rodeo 2026 summary (<code>build_summary.py</code>). All rodeo
          data are preliminary.</p>
        <p>Where to look next:
          <a href="https://e-abdi.github.io/Glider-Operation-Best-Practices/">Glider Operation Best Practices</a> ·
          <a href="https://open-source-glider.readthedocs.io/en/latest/">Open-source glider wiki</a> ·
          <a href="https://github.com/e-abdi/custom-glider-sensor-integration">Custom sensor integration</a></p>
      </footer>
    </div>
</div>

<script>
const PHOTOS = {
  "slocum": "images/gliders/slocum.jpg",
  "sentinel": "images/gliders/sentinel.jpg",
  "seaglider": "images/gliders/seaglider.jpg",
  "SGX": "images/gliders/SGX.jpg",
  "seaexplorer": "images/gliders/seaexplorer.jpg",
  "spray": "images/gliders/spray.jpg",
  "spray2": "images/gliders/spray2.jpg",
  "oceanscout": "images/gliders/oceanscout.jpg",
  "petrel": "images/gliders/petrel.jpg",
  "mod2": "images/gliders/mod2.jpg",
  "SG1-Lura": "images/gliders/SG1-Lura.jpg"
};

const PAM = {

const DEPTH_SCALE = 1500, END_SCALE = 760;
// Depth spans 50 m to full ocean depth, so the slider steps through stops rather
// than sliding linearly — otherwise the shelf range is one pixel wide.
const DEPTH_STOPS = [50, 100, 150, 200, 300, 400, 500, 600, 800, 1000,
                     1200, 1500, 2000, 3000, 4000, 6000, 8000, 10000, 11000];
const el = (t, c, txt) => { const n = document.createElement(t); if (c) n.className = c; if (txt != null) n.textContent = txt; return n; };
const num = n => n.toLocaleString("en-US");
// kind -> [badge class, label]. "paper" borrows the derived colour: both mean
// "someone worked this out", as opposed to a vendor stating it.
const CONF = { measured: ["measured", "At sea"], vendor: ["vendor", "Vendor"],
               derived: ["derived", "Derived"], paper: ["derived", "Paper"] };

// ---------- requirement state ----------
const REQS = ["duration", "depth", "speed", "mass", "freq", "duty"];
const CAPS = ["rt", "pam", "edge", "bathy", "ice", "backseat", "prop", "rodeo"];
let applied = null;

function readForm() {
  const s = { on: {}, val: {}, caps: {} };
  REQS.forEach(k => {
    s.on[k] = document.querySelector(`input[data-for="${k}"]`).checked;
    const raw = Number(document.getElementById("r-" + k).value);
    s.val[k] = k === "depth" ? DEPTH_STOPS[raw] : raw;
  });
  CAPS.forEach(k => { s.caps[k] = document.getElementById("cap-" + k).checked; });
  s.battery = document.querySelector('input[name="battery"]:checked').value;
  return s;
}

function matches(g, s) {
  if (s.caps.rt && !g.realTime) return false;
  if (s.caps.pam && !g.pam.length) return false;
  if (s.caps.edge && !g.edge) return false;
  if (s.caps.bathy && !g.bathy) return false;
  if (s.caps.ice && !g.ice) return false;
  if (s.caps.backseat && !g.backseat) return false;
  if (s.caps.prop && !g.propeller) return false;
  if (s.caps.rodeo && !g.rodeo) return false;
  if (s.on.duration && g.endurance[1] < s.val.duration) return false;
  if (s.on.depth && (!g.depth || g.depth[1] < s.val.depth)) return false;
  if (s.on.speed && (g.speedKt == null || g.speedKt < s.val.speed)) return false;
  if (s.on.mass && (g.massKg == null || g.massKg > s.val.mass)) return false;
  if (s.on.freq && !bestPam(g, s.val.freq)) return false;
  if (s.battery === "rechargeable" && g.batteryType !== "rechargeable" && g.batteryType !== "both") return false;
  if (s.battery === "primary" && g.batteryType !== "primary" && g.batteryType !== "both") return false;
  return true;
}

// ---------- acoustic fit ----------
function bestPam(g, freqKhz) {
  const able = g.pam.map(k => PAM[k]).filter(p => p && p.maxKhz != null && p.maxKhz >= freqKhz);
  if (!able.length) return null;
  return able.sort((a, b) => (b.storageGb || 0) - (a.storageGb || 0))[0];
}

function storageGb(freqKhz, bits, dutyPct, days) {
  const sr = 2 * freqKhz * 1000;                       // Nyquist
  const bytesPerSec = sr * (bits / 8) * (dutyPct / 100);
  return (bytesPerSec * 86400 * days) / 1e9;
}

function fitLines(g, s) {
  const out = [];
  const days = s.on.duration ? s.val.duration : 30;
  const freq = s.on.freq ? s.val.freq : null;
  const duty = s.on.duty ? s.val.duty : 25;

  if (freq != null) {
    const p = bestPam(g, freq);
    if (!p) {
      out.push({ k: "warn", ic: "✕", html: `No listed payload covers <b>${freq} kHz</b> on this platform` });
    } else if (p.storageGb) {
      const need = storageGb(freq, p.bits, duty, days);
      const ok = need <= p.storageGb;
      const fmtGb = v => v >= 1000 ? (v / 1000).toFixed(1) + " TB" : Math.round(v) + " GB";
      out.push({
        k: ok ? "ok" : "warn", ic: ok ? "✓" : "✕",
        html: `<b>${p.name}</b> · ${freq} kHz at ${duty}% for ${days} d → ${fmtGb(need)} of ${fmtGb(p.storageGb)}`
      });
    } else {
      out.push({ k: "unknown", ic: "?", html: `<b>${p.name}</b> covers ${freq} kHz; storage not published` });
    }
  }

  if (g.rodeo && g.rodeo.watts) {
    const needWh = g.rodeo.watts * 24 * days;
    const cap = g.energy ? g.energy[1] : null;
    if (cap) {
      const ok = needWh <= cap;
      out.push({
        k: ok ? "ok" : "warn", ic: ok ? "✓" : "✕",
        html: `Energy: <b>${(needWh / 1000).toFixed(1)} kWh</b> for ${days} d at ${g.rodeo.watts} W measured, of ${(cap / 1000).toFixed(1)} kWh`
      });
    } else {
      out.push({ k: "unknown", ic: "?", html: `Measured draw <b>${g.rodeo.watts} W</b>, but no published capacity to compare` });
    }
  } else if (g.rodeo) {
    out.push({ k: "unknown", ic: "?", html: `Flew the Rodeo, but energy use could not be measured` });
  }
  return out;
}

// ---------- rendering ----------
function meter(label, frac, text, missing) {
  const row = el("div", "meter");
  row.appendChild(el("span", "k", label));
  const t = el("div", "track" + (missing ? " none" : ""));
  if (!missing) {
    const f = el("span");
    if (frac > 1) { f.className = "over"; t.title = "Beyond the full scale of this bar — see the value."; }
    f.style.width = Math.min(100, frac * 100).toFixed(1) + "%";
    t.appendChild(f);
  }
  row.appendChild(t);
  row.appendChild(el("span", "v" + (missing ? " dim" : ""), text));
  return row;
}

function specRow(k, v) {
  const r = el("div", "spec");
  r.appendChild(el("span", "sk", k));
  r.appendChild(el("span", "sv", v));
  return r;
}

function card(g, s) {
  const c = el("article", "gcard");

  const ph = el("div", "photo");
  if (PHOTOS[g.photo]) {
    const img = el("img");
    img.src = PHOTOS[g.photo];
    img.alt = g.glider + " glider";
    img.loading = "lazy";
    ph.appendChild(img);
  }
  if (g.rodeo) {
    const rib = el("span", "ribbon", "Rodeo 2026 · " + g.rodeo.names.split("·")[0].trim());
    ph.appendChild(rib);
  }
  c.appendChild(ph);

  const b = el("div", "gbody");
  const nm = el("div", "gname");
  const nmL = el("div");
  nmL.appendChild(el("h3", null, g.glider));
  nmL.appendChild(el("div", "maker", g.maker));
  nm.appendChild(nmL);
  const kind = g.rodeo ? "measured" : g.conf || (g.energyConf === "derived" ? "derived" : "vendor");
  const conf = el("span", "badge " + CONF[kind][0]);
  conf.appendChild(el("span", "dot"));
  conf.appendChild(document.createTextNode(CONF[kind][1]));
  nm.appendChild(conf);
  b.appendChild(nm);

  b.appendChild(el("p", "affordance", g.affordance));

  const m = el("div");
  m.appendChild(g.depth
    ? meter("Depth", g.depth[1] / DEPTH_SCALE, num(g.depth[1]) + " m")
    : meter("Depth", 0, "not published", true));
  m.appendChild(meter("Endurance", g.endurance[1] / END_SCALE,
    g.endurance[0] === g.endurance[1] ? num(g.endurance[1]) + " d" : num(g.endurance[0]) + "–" + num(g.endurance[1]) + " d"));
  m.appendChild(g.energy
    ? meter("Energy", g.energy[1] / 23000, (g.energy[1] / 1000).toFixed(1) + " kWh")
    : meter("Energy", 0, "not published", true));
  b.appendChild(m);

  const chips = el("div", "chips");
  chips.appendChild(el("span", "chip", g.massKg ? g.massKg + " kg" : "mass n/p"));
  chips.appendChild(el("span", "chip", g.speedKt ? g.speedKt + " kt" : "speed n/p"));
  if (g.propeller) chips.appendChild(el("span", "chip", "thruster / propeller"));
  chips.appendChild(el("span", "chip", g.pam.length ? g.pam.length + " PAM option" + (g.pam.length > 1 ? "s" : "") : "no PAM documented"));
  if (g.conflicts) {
    const f = el("span", "badge flag");
    f.appendChild(el("span", "dot"));
    f.appendChild(document.createTextNode("check " + g.conflicts.length));
    chips.appendChild(f);
  }
  b.appendChild(chips);

  const lines = fitLines(g, s);
  if (lines.length) {
    const fit = el("div", "fit");
    lines.forEach(l => {
      const row = el("div", "fit-row " + l.k);
      row.appendChild(el("span", "ic", l.ic));
      const span = el("span");
      span.innerHTML = l.html;
      row.appendChild(span);
      fit.appendChild(row);
    });
    b.appendChild(fit);
  }

  // details
  const d = el("details", "more");
  d.appendChild(el("summary", null, "Details & sources"));
  const db = el("div", "more-body");
  const specs = el("div");
  specs.appendChild(specRow("Depth", g.depthNote || (g.depth ? num(g.depth[0]) + "–" + num(g.depth[1]) + " m" : "not published")));
  specs.appendChild(specRow("Endurance", g.endNote));
  specs.appendChild(specRow("Speed", g.speedNote || (g.speedKt ? g.speedKt + " kt" : "not published")));
  specs.appendChild(specRow("Mass", g.massNote || (g.massKg ? g.massKg + " kg" : "not published")));
  specs.appendChild(specRow("Capacity", g.energy ? (g.energy[0] === g.energy[1] ? num(g.energy[1]) + " Wh" : num(g.energy[0]) + "–" + num(g.energy[1]) + " Wh") : "not published"));
  specs.appendChild(specRow("Battery", g.battery));
  specs.appendChild(specRow("Thruster / propeller", g.propeller || "none — buoyancy only"));
  specs.appendChild(specRow("Ice capable", g.ice ? "yes" : "not stated"));
  specs.appendChild(specRow("PAM options", g.pam.length ? g.pam.map(k => PAM[k].name).join(", ") : "none documented"));
  db.appendChild(specs);

  if (g.rodeo) {
    const r = el("div");
    r.appendChild(el("h4", null, ""));
    const p = el("p", "affordance");
    p.innerHTML = "<b>Rodeo 2026 (" + g.rodeo.names + "):</b> " + g.rodeo.note +
      (g.rodeo.whDive ? " Measured " + g.rodeo.whDive + " Wh/dive, " + g.rodeo.watts + " W, " + g.rodeo.whKm + " Wh/km." : "");
    r.appendChild(p);
    db.appendChild(r);
  }

  if (g.conflicts) {
    const cf = el("div");
    const h = el("span", "badge flag");
    h.appendChild(el("span", "dot"));
    h.appendChild(document.createTextNode("Conflicts to check"));
    cf.appendChild(h);
    const ul = el("ul", "note-list");
    g.conflicts.forEach(x => ul.appendChild(el("li", null, x)));
    ul.style.marginTop = "6px";
    cf.appendChild(ul);
    db.appendChild(cf);
  }

  if (g.notes && g.notes.length) {
    const ul = el("ul", "note-list");
    g.notes.forEach(x => ul.appendChild(el("li", null, x)));
    db.appendChild(ul);
  }

  const links = el("div", "linkrow");
  const add = (href, label) => { const a = el("a", null, label); a.href = href; a.target = "_blank"; a.rel = "noopener"; links.appendChild(a); };
  if (g.website) add(g.website, "Manufacturer");
  if (g.paper) add(g.paper, "Paper");
  if (g.bp) add(BP + g.bp, "Best practices");
  add(WIKI, "Wiki");
  add(INTEG, "Sensor integration");
  if (g.glider.includes("Slocum")) add(ENDURANCE_CALC, "Endurance calculator");
  db.appendChild(links);

  d.appendChild(db);
  b.appendChild(d);

  c.appendChild(b);
  return c;
}

function tableRow(g) {
  const tr = el("tr");
  const cells = [
    [g.maker, false],
    [g.glider, false],
    [g.depth ? num(g.depth[1]) : "—", true],
    [g.endurance[0] === g.endurance[1] ? num(g.endurance[1]) : num(g.endurance[0]) + "–" + num(g.endurance[1]), true],
    [g.speedKt != null ? g.speedKt.toFixed(1) : "—", true],
    [g.massKg != null ? num(g.massKg) : "—", true],
    [g.energy ? (g.energy[0] === g.energy[1] ? num(g.energy[1]) : num(g.energy[0]) + "–" + num(g.energy[1])) : "—", true],
    [g.propeller ? "yes" : "no", false],
    [g.realTime ? "yes" : "no", false],
    [g.pam.length ? "yes" : "no", false],
    [g.ice ? "yes" : "no", false],
    [g.rodeo ? "Rodeo" : "vendor", false]
  ];
  cells.forEach(([v, isNum], i) => {
    const td = el("td", isNum ? "num" : null);
    if (v === "—") { const s = el("span", "muted", "—"); td.appendChild(s); }
    else td.textContent = v;
    if (i === 11 && g.rodeo) td.style.color = "var(--measured)";
    tr.appendChild(td);
  });
  return tr;
}

function charts(list) {
  const host = document.getElementById("charts");
  host.textContent = "";
  const specs = [
    { title: "Max depth", unit: "m", get: g => g.depth ? g.depth[1] : null, fmt: v => num(v) + " m" },
    { title: "Endurance", unit: "days", get: g => g.endurance[1], fmt: v => num(v) + " d" },
    { title: "Energy capacity", unit: "kWh", get: g => g.energy ? g.energy[1] : null, fmt: v => (v / 1000).toFixed(1) + " kWh" }
  ];
  specs.forEach(sp => {
    const box = el("div", "chart");
    box.appendChild(el("h4", null, sp.title));
    const vals = list.map(sp.get).filter(v => v != null);
    const max = vals.length ? Math.max(...vals) : 1;
    [...list].sort((a, b) => (sp.get(b) ?? -1) - (sp.get(a) ?? -1)).forEach(g => {
      const v = sp.get(g);
      const row = el("div", "bar" + (v == null ? " nodata" : ""));
      row.appendChild(el("span", "n", g.glider));
      const bar = el("div", "b" + (g.rodeo ? " measured" : ""));
      if (v != null) { const f = el("span"); f.style.width = ((v / max) * 100).toFixed(1) + "%"; bar.appendChild(f); }
      row.appendChild(bar);
      row.appendChild(el("span", "val", v == null ? "no data" : sp.fmt(v)));
      box.appendChild(row);
    });
    box.appendChild(el("p", "foot", "Bars share one scale, longest = " + sp.fmt(max) + "."));
    host.appendChild(box);
  });
}

function render() {
  const s = applied;
  const list = GLIDERS.filter(g => matches(g, s));
  const cards = document.getElementById("cards");
  const tbody = document.getElementById("tbody");
  cards.textContent = "";
  tbody.textContent = "";
  list.forEach(g => { cards.appendChild(card(g, s)); tbody.appendChild(tableRow(g)); });
  document.getElementById("empty").hidden = list.length > 0;
  const any = REQS.some(k => s.on[k]) || CAPS.some(k => s.caps[k]);
  document.getElementById("count").innerHTML = any
    ? `<b>${list.length}</b> of ${GLIDERS.length} gliders meet your requirements`
    : `<b>${GLIDERS.length}</b> gliders — set requirements above to narrow the list`;
  charts(list);
}

// ---------- wiring ----------
REQS.forEach(k => {
  const range = document.getElementById("r-" + k);
  const check = document.querySelector(`input[data-for="${k}"]`);
  const row = document.getElementById("sl-" + k);
  const out = document.getElementById("v-" + k);
  const sync = () => {
    out.textContent = k === "speed" ? Number(range.value).toFixed(1)
      : k === "depth" ? num(DEPTH_STOPS[range.value]) : range.value;
    row.classList.toggle("off", !check.checked);
    document.getElementById("dirty").hidden = false;
  };
  range.addEventListener("input", () => { if (!check.checked) check.checked = true; sync(); });
  check.addEventListener("change", sync);
});
CAPS.forEach(k => document.getElementById("cap-" + k)
  .addEventListener("change", () => { document.getElementById("dirty").hidden = false; }));
document.querySelectorAll('input[name="battery"]').forEach(r =>
  r.addEventListener("change", () => { document.getElementById("dirty").hidden = false; }));
  
document.getElementById("apply").addEventListener("click", () => {
  applied = readForm();
  document.getElementById("dirty").hidden = true;
  render();
});
document.getElementById("reset").addEventListener("click", () => {
  REQS.forEach(k => { document.querySelector(`input[data-for="${k}"]`).checked = false; document.getElementById("sl-" + k).classList.add("off"); });
  CAPS.forEach(k => { document.getElementById("cap-" + k).checked = false; });
  document.getElementById("batt-any").checked = true;
  applied = readForm();
  document.getElementById("dirty").hidden = true;
  render();
});

const vc = document.getElementById("view-cards"), vt = document.getElementById("view-table");
vc.addEventListener("click", () => {
  vc.setAttribute("aria-pressed", "true"); vt.setAttribute("aria-pressed", "false");
  document.getElementById("cards").hidden = false; document.getElementById("tableview").hidden = true;
});
vt.addEventListener("click", () => {
  vt.setAttribute("aria-pressed", "true"); vc.setAttribute("aria-pressed", "false");
  document.getElementById("cards").hidden = true; document.getElementById("tableview").hidden = false;
});

applied = readForm();
render();
</script>
```
